instructions.en: Used to record text descriptions associated with a resource. Where appropriate different types of description may be recorded.

helptext.en:
Full Address

Where it is convenient, this can be used to record the full address. This can be used to aid migration from legacy systems with less sophisticated recording practice

Address Parts

To better represent the complexity of addresses each constituent part has been modelled.

Building Name

Use to record the actual name of a building where known.

Building Number

Use to record the number(s) assigned to a building. This may be a single number (eg. 45) or a range separated by a '-' (eg. 13-21).

Building Number Sub-Street

Used to record events relating to a particular Heritage Resource. Activities can be used to give context and meaning to the records of monuments or areas. They provide information on ‘how we know what we know’ (for example investigative activities or research and analysis) or on how a particular Monument or Area has been managed through time (management activities).
